title: Decent
text: Decent. This chair was all right. It was decent. It was not the most cushioned but not terrible. It looks nice and my son liked it. It is nice that it reclines and has the colors. The pillow did end up ripping after not that long. I think the quality was kind of in the middle, not stupendous but not terrible. It wasn't too hard to put together. It looked like the picture.
